decisions.reason: The email-to-SMS gateway is new, sits close to the established messaging platform and costs little to keep running, and one year on its own page does not yet show whether demand will materialize, so the option stays open.

The SMS-to-email gateway reuses existing messaging infrastructure and complements Product B, and its prospects are still uncertain, so keeping this low-cost option open is preferable to abandoning it this early, though dropping Product A shows inbound SMS demand may be weak.
